exposure: Number of pregnant WWE treated each year
Specialty of board members (neurologist vs. neurosurgeon)
outcome: Knowledge score regarding pregnancy in women with epilepsy
Clinical practices related to managing pregnant women with epilepsy
Barriers encountered in managing pregnant women with epilepsy
cohort: Board members of the Zhejiang Association Against Epilepsy (ZAAE)
finding: Neurologists had a higher knowledge score regarding pregnancy in women with epilepsy compared to neurosurgeons, and the biggest barrier to management was identified as a lack of patient and doctor education.
mod_finding: This study assessed knowledge about pregnancy in women with epilepsy, including risks of cesarean section and preterm delivery, but did not directly examine mode of delivery outcomes.
